findings.F1: In choppy markets on folds B and C, the deeper the 20-day fall, the more the coin lags its 5-day drift. Falls of 10–15 % were followed by −3.3 % (15 cases, t −2.39), falls of 15–20 % by −8.6 % (16 cases, t −2.18) and falls of 20–30 % by −11.6 % (10 cases, t −1.62). Shallow falls of 0–10 % were followed by only −1.0 % to −3.0 % (t −0.33 and −1.94). This is the tested idea's grading, but on few cases.
findings.F2: Deep 20-day falls (−10 % or worse) kept falling in calm markets in all three trends. Falling calm: −3.5 % over 5 days (112 cases, 36 days, t −1.98). Choppy calm: −6.9 % (28 cases, t −1.99). Rising calm: −8.8 % (17 cases, t −1.96).
findings.F3: In falling agitated markets the same deep falls did not continue: +1.1 % (185 cases, 48 days, t +0.48). Falls deeper than 30 % in falling markets gave −0.05 % (88 cases, t −0.02). The continuation is a calm-market effect, and the agitated side is the rebound family the profile map already holds (16 falling-agitated long books).
findings.F4: One window carries the whole book. Summed over coin-days in a position, the book made +0.19, while w16 alone made +1.23. Without w16 it lost about −1.04, with w11 at −0.38, w17 at −0.47 and w18 at −0.24. This fits the failed one-window-left-out Sharpe of −0.147.
findings.F5: On days in a position the book's daily return moved against the coin's, as a short should (correlation −0.74 over 1,222 coin-days). The coins fell −0.39 % a day on those days, yet the book earned only +0.015 % a day. Most of the coins' fall did not reach the book after sizing and timing.
findings.F6: The brief's own pattern shows only weakly. In choppy agitated markets, closes in the top fifth of the day's range were followed by −4.6 % over 5 days, but on 10 cases over 9 days (t −2.51), after many angles were tried. In choppy calm markets the same closes were followed by +3.6 % (34 cases, t +0.90). These checks used each window's own median swing, not the profile's past-year median. This is too thin to count as a finding on its own.
findings.F7: Weekday and range width showed nothing that stands out after this many angles. No weekday reached |t| 1.8 (Wednesday −2.4 %, t −1.77). No range tercile within a trend reached |t| 1.9 (rising mid-range +2.5 %, t 1.87).

ideas.idea: In a calm market, a coin whose 20-day return is a deep fall keeps falling over the next five days, and the deeper that 20-day fall, the larger the further fall.
ideas.consequence: A trader shorts coins that have dropped hard over 20 days while their swing is no larger than usual, and stands aside from the same short when the market is agitated, where such falls rebound instead.
ideas.name: calm deep month fall continues
